title: Accessible action button contract
summary: Keep action variants, sizes, loading and disabled semantics in one button contract while allowing each project to implement its own visual language.
when_to_use: A product has repeated actions needing consistent emphasis, loading feedback and touch targets.
avoid_when: The element navigates to another page; use a link with link semantics instead.

anatomy.purpose: Holds short text or an icon with an accessible name.
Shows pending work without changing the button width.
Remains visible across all visual variants.

tokens.name: --action-bg
tokens.purpose: Background for the current semantic variant.

tokens.name: --focus-ring
tokens.purpose: Focus indication independent of hover color.

states.name: idle
states.behavior: Action is available and clearly labeled.

states.name: loading
states.behavior: Prevent duplicate activation and announce progress without erasing the label.

states.name: disabled
states.behavior: Remove activation while keeping the reason discoverable when relevant.

responsive: Preserve a comfortable touch target even when a compact visual size is requested.
accessibility: Use an accessible name for icon-only buttons.
Do not use color alone to distinguish destructive actions.
Keep focus visible and respect reduced motion.
implementation_steps: Define semantic variants and sizes from the project's existing tokens.
Implement loading and disabled as explicit states.
Test keyboard, touch and assistive-technology behavior.
